note: Both forecasters written before the corpus draw, before any corpus is prepared, and before any training.

forecaster_ii.name: (ii) revised n-gram-level route (plan section 1b)

level_rule.code: A0(2^23) of (i) minus 0.2011 (mean level bias on the 14 test code corpora)
level_rule.english: A0(2^23) of (i), the paper's reference-based level, unchanged
level_rule.lang (FineWeb-2): -0.0962 + 0.8134 * g, g = best n-gram cross-entropy at 2^23 (development fit)

forecaster_ii.drop_rule: 0.6924 * (S(2^23) - S(2^25)), S the information shape of (i)
forecaster_ii.english_level_choice: English keeps the reference level. Decided before the draw from test80 alone: the n-gram level was worse on the 19 test English corpora (leave-one-out 0.117 against 0.094 for the reference level).

baselines.A3: two pilots (2^19, 2^20 seed 0), power law with the locked floor rule (core.A3)
baselines.compute: each charged its learner FLOPs (core.learner_flops); data forecasts charged the reference pass at 1,000 targets and at the 20,000 run, n-gram level 0

reported: per family, paired corpus-bootstrap ratios (20,000 draws, seed 0)
c-flag counts (c = reference full-context bits per byte / best n-gram cross-entropy at 2^23 >= 0.70)
